title: Nile cruise or land tour?
standfirst: You can see Luxor and Aswan from the river or by road. Here is how the two compare on time, comfort, cost and what you see. This is part of our guide to [[up]].

sections.heading: What a cruise gives you
paragraphs: Your hotel travels with you: you unpack once. Edfu and Kom Ombo are on the way. The time between sites is spent on the river rather than in a car, and the scenery is part of the trip.

sections.heading: What a land tour gives you
paragraphs: Flexibility: you choose your hotels and the order of visits, and you can spend longer at one site. It can be quicker, as the road between Luxor and Aswan takes a few hours.

sections.heading: Cost
paragraphs: Both range widely. A cruise includes meals and often sightseeing; a land tour adds hotels, meals and transport separately. Compare what is included as well as the price.

faqs.q: Is a Nile cruise better than staying in hotels?
faqs.a: For seeing the temples between Luxor and Aswan in comfort, a cruise is hard to beat. For flexibility, a land tour suits better.
Yes. Many travellers spend a few nights in Luxor or Aswan as well as cruising.
